comments: Checks a single PDF against PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1): tags, alt text, document language, title, table headers, headings and fonts. Language, title and tab order can be fixed directly in the tool. Free, no signup; the check runs locally in the browser, so the file is never uploaded.
features: Free online PDF accessibility checker. Checks tags, alt text, document language, title, table headers, headings and fonts against PDF/UA, and fixes language, title and tab order in one click. Runs entirely in the browser: the PDF is never uploaded.
title: Filekin PDF Accessibility Checker
